items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names describe what they do (writeHeader, writeChunk, readNextChunk, decodeBase64Key, validateSourceAndFields). Constants are named (magicByte1, maxChunkSize, minSaltBytes) and public functions have doc comments. Layout follows the repo's existing style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Config adds an unrequested UnmarshalYAML with snake/kebab aliases (KeySourceUS/KeySourceHy...) and pulls yaml.v3 into the encryption package. LoadKey re-checks the empty passphrase that validateSourceAndFields already rejects. The rest is well split into small functions.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w and ErrInvalidKey. Truncation gives explicit ErrUnexpectedEOF errors, the HMAC is compared with hmac.Equal, and chunk length is bounds-checked. writeAll handles short writes, the key is copied, and Close is idempotent. The key is loaded before getStorages, so it fails fast. No secrets or silently swallowed errors.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The mandated changes are done and the nil-encryptor path keeps the same closer order (gw, pw), so unencrypted output is unchanged. storage.PathGenerator keeps its signature and passes a hardcoded false. Extras: exported WithEncryption and KeySource* constants, plus the UnmarshalYAML aliases, which expand the accepted YAML keys.
